title: Stock futures inch higher as traders weather latest rise in Treasury yields: Live updates
summary: Treasury bond yields reached their highest levels since June 2002, causing the stock market to decline with the Dow dropping over 100 points as traders adjust to rising yields.
content: The 30-year Treasury bond yield hit levels not seen since June 2002. Those moves led the Dow to a decline of more than 100 points.

zh.title: 股票期货小幅走高，交易员应对美国国债收益率最新上升：实时更新
zh.summary: 美国国债收益率达到2002年6月以来的最高水平，导致股市下跌，道琼斯指数下跌超过100点，交易员调整应对收益率上升。

title: Three takeaways from Trump's 'Super Intelligence' summit
summary: Trump hosted a 'Super Intelligence' summit at the White House focused on AI policy, occurring amid growing calls from tech leaders and experts for stricter AI regulations.
content: The meeting at the White House came as some tech bosses and experts have called for tighter rules around AI.

zh.title: 特朗普"超级智能"峰会的三大要点

title: China factory activity snaps 2-month contractionary streak in September
summary: China's manufacturing activity resumed growth in September after two months of contraction, prompting government policymakers to increase stimulus measures to support economic recovery.
content: China's factory activity returned to growth in September as a deepening economic malaise prompts policymakers to ramp up stimulus steps and bolster growth.

zh.title: 中国工厂活动在九月份打破两个月的收缩趋势

title: Beijing warns of retaliation if Europe imposes curbs on Chinese businesses
summary: China's Commerce Ministry warned it will respond decisively if the European Union imposes restrictions on Chinese businesses or products, escalating trade tensions.
content: China must "respond firmly" if the EU introduces restrictions on Chinese businesses or products, the Commerce Ministry said, according to a CNBC translation.

zh.title: 北京警告欧洲对中国企业施加限制将面临报复
zh.summary: 中国商务部警告称，如果欧盟对中国企业或产品实施限制措施，将采取果断回应，加剧贸易紧张局势。

title: ‘Don’t go with a fund, go with a solution’: CEO’s tips from decades of global investing
summary: BlueFive Capital CEO Hazem Ben-Gacem shares investment strategies from decades of global experience, emphasizing solution-focused approaches over traditional fund management.
content: BlueFive Capital CEO Hazem Ben-Gacem talks about his preferred investment areas and strategies.

title: ‘I have $400,000 in equity’: I’m 80. Should I sell my house because of dangerous stairs — or spend thousands renovating?
summary: An 80-year-old homeowner with $400,000 in equity weighs the financial trade-offs of selling versus renovating to address safety concerns while preserving a favorable mortgage rate.
content: “Generally, the advice I’ve read says not to sell because I have a low-interest-rate mortgage.”

title: Hedge funds hold a record share of the $30 trillion Treasury market. What could go wrong?
summary: Hedge funds now hold a record portion of the $30 trillion Treasury market, providing liquidity benefits but raising concerns about potential financial instability if their participation shifts suddenly.
content: Hedge funds can boost Treasury market liquidity, but their growing role also risks creating financial instability.
